notes: The ground's surface layers (simcore/scenery/ground_layers.hpp, read by LoadGroundLayers): the land cover's cells take a layer by their cover, a field's by its crop and the season (autumn_months by the scenario's date). Each layer is drawn by Unreal's ground material from its textures ("texture": an id in data/scenery/textures.json; empty: none chosen, the land cover's colour only), repeated every tile_m metres, which divides 600 m (simcore::scenery::kGroundTilePeriodM; near each scan's own width); a layer with rows turns with the field's furrows (its textures' furrows run across the image, along U, as farm_furrows' do). The summer's standing wheat, maize and sunflowers have no texture: no free scan of a standing crop exists (docs/scenery/TERRAIN_ROADMAP.md section 4). At most 16 layers. Presentation only: nothing in the simulation reads it.
source: game value: sam3d estimate (the Pannonian plain's fields, woods and villages; tile sizes to be tuned against -SimMapShots and the reference views in docs/scenery/TERRAIN_ROADMAP.md)
